# skaegis

> Your continuous shield: every CVE seen, every gap closed.

skaegis is a sovereign, self-hosted, cross-OS CVE-detection and closed-loop remediation service. It
detects known, published vulnerabilities on every Linux, Windows and macOS host you run and hands
each finding to your existing patch pipeline. It is built on unmodified upstream Wazuh (indexer,
manager and dashboard) and deployed by the SKStacks role optional/skaegis, with the dashboard behind
single sign-on. It is a detection and remediation-orchestration service, not a new scanner engine
and not a SaaS. It does not find zero-days, it does not claim complete coverage, and it does not
patch by itself: findings go to the patch pipeline (skpatch, Renovate, scheduled OS update jobs),
the agent drafts and never auto-merges, and a finding closes only when a re-scan shows the CVE gone.
It is the Detect pillar of a three-part suite: Defend (sksec), Detect (skaegis), Remediate (skpatch).
Status: design and scaffold phase; nothing here describes a shipped release.

## About smilinTux

skaegis is part of the **smilinTux sovereign AI ecosystem**, a suite of open-source tools built by
its creators to give humans and AI agents genuine, authentic infrastructure they can own and
trust. No corporate clouds, no black-box SaaS middlemen.
